load_model_info_from_json: load model info from a JSON file and return it as a dictionary keyed by model name
load_all_model_info_from_folder: load model info from all JSON files in a folder recursively and merge into a single dictionary
get_model_info_folder_path: get the filesystem path to the model_info folder for a given model name using pkg_resources
check_if_devserver: check whether the current host is a development server by inspecting the HOSTNAME environment variable
convert_model_list_to_dict: convert a list of model dictionaries into a single dictionary keyed by each model's name field
